transcript:
This is NPR News Now, the latest headlines every hour.
Live from NPR News in Washington, I'm Louise Skivone.
On Capitol Hill, a top House Democrat is expanding his investigation into the venture capital
fund 1789, and President Trump's eldest son, NPR's Barbara Sprunt, has more on that story.
Jamie Raskin, the likely incoming chair of the House Judiciary Committee, sent letters
on Monday evening to four companies backed by 1789 Capitol, defense contractor Hadrian,
vape maker Jewel, prediction market Polymarket, and the online firearms seller Grabagun.
The Maryland Democrat requested two years' worth of documents.
He's investigating whether the president's son used his political influence to boost
the companies.
An attorney representing 1789 Capitol called the allegations "personal attacks untethered
to actual evidence."
This is one part of a broader oversight agenda for Democrats when they take control of Congress
in January.
Barbara Sprunt, NPR News, Washington.
Israel is celebrating the return of NVIDIA's chief executive.
NPR's Daniel Astrin tells us the chip-making company has driven big economic gains for
Israel.
NVIDIA has a large research and development presence in Israel.
According to Israeli government statistics, NVIDIA's revenue contributed to nearly half
of Israel's economic growth this past quarter.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu welcomed the return of Jensen Huang as NVIDIA's CEO.
Netanyahu said continuity for the company's leadership was good news.
And Israeli President Isaac Herzog spoke to Huang after he was reinstated to the company.
The Israeli president thanked Huang for supporting Israel, quote, "especially during this challenging
time," an apparent reference to Israel's international isolation because of the Gaza
War.
Daniel Astrin, NPR News, Tel Aviv.
New research shows people taking GLP-1 drugs for weight loss may also see higher breast
density and subsequent mammograms.
NPR's Yuki Noguchi explains what this means.
The study looked back at 107 women, age 39 to 79, who had gotten mammograms before and
after starting a regimen of GLP-1 drugs like Wagavi or ZEPFOUND.
Breast density increased for 62.5 percent of women.
Normally, dense breasts are associated with higher breast cancer risk, in part because
the fibroglangellar tissue can obscure tumors.
But in this case, researchers are not yet certain that the tissue composition of the
breast or the cancer risk changes with GLP-1 use.
The researchers advise people taking the drugs to continue routine breast cancer screening
as recommended.
Yuki Noguchi, NPR News.
On Wall Street, the Dow was back over 50,000 points at 50,018, gaining 423.
After significant gains yesterday, the Nasdaq was off 356.
This is NPR News.
Almost all of the midterm results have been tied down, and today the 259th House Democrat
seat has been confirmed in the state of Tennessee for Victoria Broderick, who defeated Republican
incumbent Scott Desjardins.
As Thanksgiving feasts begin, experts recommend following a few key food safety tips to keep
foodborne illness away from your holiday table, and PR's Maria Godoy has details.
First, keep a clean kitchen.
Wash your hands before preparing food, clean and sanitized surfaces, and cutting boards.
And make sure to keep raw meat separate from foods that don't get cooked, such as salad
vegetables and breads.
If you use a cutting board for raw meat, make sure to put it in the sink so no one else
accidentally uses it for other foods.
If you're cooking turkey, it should reach an internal temperature of 165 degrees to
kill harmful bacteria, says David Love of Johns Hopkins University.
So I like to keep a meat thermometer handy, and that's a great way to tell when your
meal's done.
It says, "Chill any leftovers in the fridge or cooler within two hours of serving to prevent
the growth of bacteria."
Maria Godoy, NPR News.
FIFA confirms the U.S. will co-host another soccer World Cup event.
It will be the 2031 Women's World Cup co-hosted with Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica.
The project offers FIFA a choice of stadiums in 20 cities, 14 of them will be in the U.S.,
or will be in Mexico with the rest in San Jose.
I'm Louise Kivoni, NPR News, Washington.

Israel celebrates NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement, citing the company's economic boost to Israel
Study links GLP-1 weight-loss drugs to higher breast density in women receiving mammograms
